doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth name, birthplace and the middle name Iweanya
summary: Born in New Orleans in 1960; his middle name Iweanya honors a friend of his father from Kenya.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yeah. So if we could start from the very beginning and if you could give us your birth name, birthplace and birth date?
Branford Marsalis, born at Flint Goodrich Hospital on October [August] 26, 1960 in New Orleans.
And is that your complete name?
My father’s friend. My father had a friend from, I think, Kenya. Kenya, no. Yeah, Kenya. And he honored him.
I noticed that many of your brothers have, should I say, unorthodox names…not, unusual names, so maybe we’ll talk a little bit more about that.
